name: ormar-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is ormar, an async ORM for Python built on SQLAlchemy and pydantic. Its models are
queried through `QuerySet` (filtering, exclusion, ordering, column selection, pagination, aggregation, bulk
create, update and delete), related through foreign keys and many-to-many relations whose related rows are
reached through `QuerysetProxy`, and run on a `DatabaseConnection` that executes queries and manages
transactions.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is ormar's query, relation and transaction layer: the ormar/queryset/ package, the ormar/relations/ package, the ormar/databases/ package and ormar/exceptions.py, together with the Queries documentation pages (docs/queries/), the Relations documentation pages (docs/relations/), docs/transactions.md, the example scripts those pages include or sit beside (docs_src/queries/, docs_src/relations/, docs_src/aggregations/, docs_src/select_columns/ and docs_src/fields/docs001.py, docs002.py and docs003.py) and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages, the example
